infoEmbedDescription: WolfStar is a multipurpose Discord bot with moderation, management and fun tools, built by the WolfStar Project.
deprecatedMessage: Message based commands are **deprecated**, and will be removed in the future. You should use the {{command}} slash command instead!

slashOnlyDetailedDescription.extendedHelp: This command is only available via slash commands. Please use the slash command instead.

slashOnlyErrorMessage: This command is only available via slash commands. Please use the slash command instead.
optionsReasonDescription: The reason, recorded in the moderation log.
optionsDurationDescription: How long the action lasts, for example 30m, 2h or 7d.
optionsMessageDescription: The message the case is about, as its link or its ID. It is linked and forwarded in the log.
messageReferenceInvalid: `{{parameter}}` is not the link or the ID of a message of this server.
optionsDmDescription: Whether to send the user a direct message about the action.
optionsAuthoredDescription: Whether to show your name in the direct message.
optionsChannelDescription: The channel to use, defaults to the current one.
optionsShowDescription: Whether to show the response publicly (default: no).
optionsTargetDescription: The role or user to configure.
